title: The Trick of “Positive Knowledge”
body:
Dastoor yaa RijaalAllah, madad, astaghfirullah. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah
w'Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd. Ya Rabbana, Anta Rabbuna, Anta hasbuna, Anta waliyuna,
Anta mawlana wa nahnu `abeeduka ad-du`afa muhtaajeen... faghfir lana maa madaa yaa wasi` al-karamee
sabirna! Ya Rabbana, `ibaad bi jaahi habeebika al-Mustafa nahnu `abeeduka ad-du`afa fuqaraa muhtaajeen!
alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala 'd-dawaam `ala habeebu 'r-rahmaan, sayyidi 'l-awaleen wa 'l-akhireen Sayyidina
Muhammad, ishfa-` lana ya sayyidu'r-rusul-kiraam ishfa` lana li-anna shafa`tak matlooban, marghoobun wa
maqboolan, shafa`tak la turad, Ya Rasulullah!
As-salamu `alaykum, our listeners, wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. Allahumma al-himna rushdana bi jaahi
nabiyyika al-Mustafa (s).
O our protector through life on this planet, master of this planet, qutb-uz-zamaan! We are running to you for
heavenly support. Now we are so weak, so hopeless. We are in need of your support, O our master, qutb-uzzamaan. To be a qutub is an appointment from the Lord of Heavens: He may grant that. We are saying,
a`udhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. We are fearing from our ego's dirtiness, because dirtiness is not
for Divine Presence as we have been ordered to make ablution for prayers. Also, we are in need of reaching
heavenly presence of the Lord of Heavens' cleanliness, ••••••••••• ••••••••• wa theeyaabaka fa-tahhir - And thy

garments keep free from stain! (74:4)
O our Muslim Arabs or Arab Muslims! Are you understanding, fa thiyaabaka fa't-tahir? Do you think that one
who is cleaning and changing his underwear three times a day, changing their clothes outside, that is
cleanliness? Allah Almighty ordering when He is saying, ••••••••••• ••••••••• - wa fatheeyaabaka fa-tahhir
••••••••••••••• •••••••••• wa yutahirakum tatheeran - make you pure and spotless. (33:33) It means that it is
tatheer not like taharah (purity), but it is tatheer. Allah Almighty asking that his servants be so clean, ghaya,
the last point that you can make yourself to be clean. The Lord of Heavens asking for the last point of
cleanliness. Don’t leave on yourself or on your clothes particularly, don’t leave any dirtiness on your real
personality that is thrown on you by Shaytan and devils. Shaytan and devils are so harees, eager, to make
Mankind dirty. That is their last aim against Mankind, who are clean and honored in the Divine Presence as
His deputies. The deputy must try to be full or complete, perfect, clean ones. That is holy command from
Heavens to Mankind, wa fatheeyaabaka fa-tahhir.
O Man! You are living on this planet for some time. Through your life on this planet so many occasions are
given to everyone, as well as to Shaytan and its armies, to make the servants of the Lord to not be clean, (but
to be) dirty! Heavenly order, “Be clean!” and Shaytan calling people, “Don’t listen. Come after me and enjoy
yourself. Don’t believe what they are saying about cleaning. I am calling you to enjoy yourself as much as you
can. And when you are going back to your home, take a shower. Finished.” Cheating people. “Don’t worry if
you are falling into sewage channels. Don’t worry! Get in those sewage channels. Get in and drink and eat,
and swim in it. Don’t say, 'We are going to be dirty,' no, get out and take a shower, finished.” That is Shaytan's
teachings on this planet for Mankind.
There are two teaching centers, one belongs to Heavens and the second to Hells, to darkness territories, more
darkness. One is enlightened ways for reaching more and coming close, much closer to the Oceans of
Lightening through Allah Almighty’s endless Heaven Oceans. Through Heaven Oceans endless dominions of
the Lord of Heavens looking after you to come there. And second one is dark, black holes calling, Shaytan
asking to cheat people, “Come after me, come and enter in it. You should be very happy and joyful.”
Therefore, O people, I am saying something through my master to you. Did you ever see a scenery lighted on
stage while play is going on? They are making it dark, shutting down the lights and people sitting through

dark place for looking at something. Shaytan saying, “O people, I am taking you now through these darkest
territories to enlightened territories. You should find so many things through that darkness. You are going to
see so many things. If we are not using that darkness, you can’t see anything on screen. No. Therefore, I am
putting you into darkness and, after darkness, you should see so many things.” But really you are just in
darkness of black hole, putting you in it, then you will see there. If you are not coming to sit into darkness, it
is not going to appear. That is Shaytanic teaching.
Shaytan is using thousands of tricks and traps. When you are entering through darkness, you are not seeing
anything. What you are doing, you are not understanding. It means you are just caught by darkness waiters
from Shaytan carrying you and making a stage, saying, “Look, look, look.” “Yes, I am looking, but I am not
there; I am not living in that stage, I am here.” If anyone is using his mentality there, Shaytan is quickly
taking that one outside. “We are not seeing anything. We are not there.” Shaytan is kicking him outside not to
cheat other people and to tell. Therefore, Shaytan is using countless traps and tricks on people for cheating
them, to not listen to prophets, the heavenly messengers; to what they are saying and teaching, saying, “This
is nothing. I am coming to cheat you.”
Therefore, in our days Shaytan making people, particularly learned people, to say, “We have a mentality,
enough zaka and `aqil (intelligence, cleverness) and we must try to make our cleverness an unchangeable
balance; there is a balance for everything. We must use our cleverness as our lord. We must bow in front of
our cleverness and positive knowledge.” They are doing that as (if) they are gods. They are saying, “(There is)
no god, (there is) only what we are looking and seeing from our minds and positive knowledge, that’s it. We
are bowing in front of that.” That is biggest sin for humanity making their faces to be changed and to be taken
from them heavenly lights that were granted when they were coming to this life from the wombs of their
mothers. When you are looking at a baby when coming it is so innocent, but when he is growing up, Shaytan
is playing with his understanding, playing through his cleverness. He is trying to make them not to believe in
the Lord of Heavens.
They are saying, “Nothing is up. Everything is in front of you.” Positivism. They are saying, “We must
approach something, then we are believing positive knowledge.” That is their understanding and it is false,
one hundred percent. Not one hundred percent, a thousand percent. Now whole world is believing in such
nonsense ideas that Shaytan teaching them, saying, “Don’t believe in such a one that you are not seeing or

approving him. But you must have, if you are asking a lord for yourself, positive knowledge. Enough for you.”
Therefore, there is a very famous branch of ideas in our days, Positivism, refusing everything about
spirituality. Saying, “We are not accepting. Only we are accepting positive knowledge, and we are positive
people.” That is Shaytanic teachings.
All prophets came with heavenly powers granted to them. If you are looking at their faces, you should enjoy
them and be full with a pleasure. For what reason? (Mawlana has a coughing bout.) Shaytan never likes that I
may speak, making coughing for me! Curse on you, l`aanatullah `alayh on that one! Sayyidina Yusuf (a) had
been granted to be so handsome. All prophets, their faces like moon so handsome, that was a grant from
heavens to human nature. The Egyptian people were in a drought and coming and standing in front of palace
of Sayyidina Yusuf (a). Sayyidina Yusuf (a) coming, standing and giving salaam to them. When they looked at
his face, they forgot their hunger. They kept on looking, looking, looking. When Sayyidina Yusuf (a) going
into his palace, people were still standing there for three days like this. Three days that noor of his beauty
until closing, they are looking and for forty days they are not feeling hunger!
The Lord of Heavens giving such beauty and lights to his divine servants. Therefore, Sayyidina Yusuf (a) was
the most beautiful among prophets, (Mawlana stands) but beauty of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s) even more. If Yusuf (a) was a crescent, Sayyidina Muhammad (s) like a full moon! Or
Sayyidina Yusuf (a) was like a moon then Sayyidina Muhammad (s) like sun shining despite (what) Wahabi
and Salafi people (say). I am giving nothing for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s), (only) Allah (swt) is
giving to him and dressing that beauty on His most beloved servant!
As-saalamu `alaykum, O our listeners! Don’t say that knowledge is only for those people who are learning
something through colleges, high schools, academies or universities. Don’t believe that all knowledge and its
lightening for them. No, they have been given only a very small spot like an atom. Hear and believe! I am a
translator for the honored ones in heavenly levels for the presence of Allah Almighty. They are granted
something appearing from the smallest light. If appearing from one that granted a heavenly light, this world
going to disappear through that light. Don’t say, “O Shaykh, you are exaggerating.” It is not mubaalagha. It is
the smallest thing I can say only, because their minds can’t carry. If we are going to speak something on that
point, their minds going to be solid like stone. No understanding and no feeling. Don’t say that we are doing
too much, no; it is not too much, but too small!

That is about prophecy. They are granting a little tonight for people on how they have been granted heavenly
beauty and handsomeness; you can’t imagine! Therefore, those who have been granted such a knowledge
from heavens are awliyaa, saints. If you are looking at one of them, you can’t carry. Even to look to their eyes,
you may fall. Therefore, they are mostly closing and not showing. If anyone asking to look through their eyes,
they are tiring and becoming ashamed and retreating.
But those people who are followers of positive knowledge as Shaytan teaching to them, you can’t look to their
faces, so ugly, so ugly! If you are looking for three days you can’t eat something, such ugly ones. Those
claiming against holy knowledge are saying, “We are representative of positive knowledge.” Look at their
faces. You can’t even look at their faces for ten seconds, so ugly. Bring their photos here and look at them.
What you should see? O my Lord! O Rabbuna, O Rabbuna wa Rabbu 'l-`alameen.
That is from tonight’s association. A little bit changing coming tonight, as He likes about His deputies on
Earth; prophets, messengers from heavens. People who are not accepting heavenly lights, their faces through
darkness and they have also a bad breathing. You can’t approach them because of that dirty breathing. Also,
from their body coming such a dirty smelling. Doesn’t matter whether they use soaps and perfumes, their
bodies smell dirty. But those people who are taking from heavens, their bodies giving perfume to people. O
people, try to cling to the ways of imaan and Holy Qur'an. Prophet (s) saying, “Try to do this.” You can’t reach
to that point till you are following one of heavens representatives. Look after that.
Fatihah. May Allah forgive us, O People.
Dome dome dome dome 5x
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Dome dome dome dome 8x
Fatihah.

(45 minutes) Thank you, our listeners! May Allah bless you.
Dome dome dome dome 4x
As-salaamu ` alaykum!
